content:
Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the RRB NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate Level Recruitment CEN 07/2025 Result with Score Card 2026 and CBT II Admit Card. Candidates enrolled in this vacancy can check the exam result, score card, answer key, exam city and admit card. Read the notification for Commercial Cum Ticket Clerk, Train Clerk, Accounts Clerk Cum Typist and Junior Clerk Cum Typist eligibility, post information, selection procedure, age limit, pay scale and other details.

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)

RRB NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate Level Recruitment 2025

RRB NTPC UG Exam 2026 CEN 07/2025: Short Details of Notification

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 28/10/2025
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 04/12/2025
  • Last Date Pay Exam Fee: 06/12/2025
  • Correction / Modified Form: 07-16 December 2025
  • Application Status Available: 06/02/2026
  • Exam Date: 07-09 May, 13-15 and 16-20 June 2026
  • Exam City Available: 10 Days Before Exam
  • Admit Card Available: 4 Days Before Exam
  • Answer Key Available: 27/06/2026
  • CBT I Result Available: 24/08/2026
  • CBT I Score Card Available: 26/08/2026
  • CBT II Exam Date: 17/09/2026
  • CBT II Exam City Available: 07/09/2026
  • CBT II Admit Card Available: 13/09/2026

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: 500/-
  • SC / ST / Female: 250/-
  • PH (Divyang): 250/-
  • After appearing in Stage I Exam, General / OBC / EWS refund: 400/-
  • After appearing in Stage I Exam, SC / ST / Female / PH refund: 250/-

Pay the examination fee through cash at E Challan or Debit Card, Credit Card and Net Banking.

RRB NTPC 10+2 Notification 2025: Age Limit as on 01/01/2025

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age: 30 Years

Age relaxation is available as per RRB NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate CEN 07/2025 recruitment rules.

RRB NTPC 10+2 Recruitment 2025: Vacancy Details

Total: 3050 Post

Post: Various posts under Non Technical Popular Categories Under Graduate Level CEN 07/2025

Eligibility: 10+2 Intermediate passed from a recognized board in India. For more eligibility details, read the notification.

RRB NTPC Under Graduate Level Post Wise Vacancy Details

  • Commercial Cum Ticket Clerk: 2424
  • Accounts Clerk Cum Typist: 394
  • Junior Clerk Cum Typist: 163
  • Trains Clerk: 77

How to Fill RRB NTPC 10+2 Recruitment Online Form 2025

  • Apply between 28/10/2025 to 04/12/2025.
  • Read the notification before applying for the RRB NTPC 10+2 Recruitment 2025 form.
  • Collect eligibility, ID proof, address and basic details.
  • Keep scanned photo, signature and ID proof ready.
  • Check the preview and every column carefully before submitting.
  • Pay the required application fee to complete the form.
  • Take a printout of the final submitted form.
